output.summary: KEP-758 proposed moving the Ingress resource from extensions.v1beta1 to networking.v1beta1 and graduating the Ingress API, with bug fixes, to GA. The KEP's status is implemented at stable stage.
output.rationale: The extensions API group is deprecated and Ingress was the last non-deprecated type in it, and a group migration takes about three minor version cycles. Ingress had been beta for a long time and had de facto GA status through wide adoption, so the design copies the API into a permanent group and declares it a V1 rather than deleting it or waiting for a replacement API.

alternatives.option: Delete the current resource from extensions.v1beta1 in anticipation of an improved API
alternatives.why_not: The readme says this option does not seem realistic in a short-term time frame, since a new API would need design and alpha/beta/ga phases, and there are enough users that the existing API cannot be deleted outright.

alternatives.option: Abandon Ingress without a full replacement
alternatives.why_not: The readme says abandoning it without a full replacement is not a viable approach, and that it is clearly a useful API capturing a non-trivial set of use cases.

alternatives.option: Keep the API as-is, or with minor changes, in beta under extensions.v1beta1
alternatives.why_not: The readme says the migration should be started sooner rather than later so the extensions group can be cleaned up, and that the change prepares the API for GA; the readme's proposed path is to copy the API into networking.v1beta1 with conversion of existing data.

evidence.quote: The `extensions` API group is considered deprecated. Ingress is the last non-deprecated API in that group.
Such an API group migration takes three minor version cycles (~9 months) to ensure compatibility.
Option 1 does not seem realistic in a short-term time frame (a new API will need to be taken through design, alpha/beta/ga phases).
At this point, it seems more prudent to declare the current API as something the community will support as a V1, codifying its status
Move Ingress to a permanent API group. (status: implemented)
